name: Dualling in Milford 2026
information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTk0NDk1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--a6d152c31ce90365f027261328bf29dcc632de0f/Dualling%20with%20words%20very%20small.jpg) Dualling in Milford 2026 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. This competition is open to all competitors regardless of age, experience, or skill. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary. *NZ's first Dual Round competition!* For dual rounds, every competitor completes two rounds (5 solves each round) of the event, with the best result from either round determining the competitor's ranking. This competition has Dual Rounds for 3x3 and Clock.
